north_star: Determine whether meaningful call-option pressure occurs before an abnormal underlying-equity response and measure the lag without assuming the hypothesis is true.

questions.structural: Does qualifying call-option pressure precede an abnormal equity response?
questions.temporal: When did pressure begin, when did the response begin, and what is the lag under available timestamp provenance?
questions.economic_later: After legitimate detection and realistic execution delay, how much favorable movement remains and does approximately 25bp remain often enough to matter?

anti_look_ahead: Do not attribute information available only at qualification or emission to onset or to an earlier economic decision clock.
